title: The silent-undo check reads a renamed file as a rename, not as a reversed hunk
why: Incident, Oct 29 15:52 CDT (coordinator): joyous#53 was refused at merge ("gates.yml: hunk reversed, undoing 1e4db8df7") though the lane only renamed gates.yml to checks.yml and bumped pins. check_silent_undo runs git with --no-renames, so a rename reads as a reversed hunk.
note: Lane started Oct 29 15:52 CDT (coordinator; session_013NEJL3d2kTUJYvWXpi3Z8p). Red first: a rename-only diff is refused today; green after, while a real reversed hunk is still refused. Needs no answer. Port: the check is shared, so every repo gets it on its next pin bump. joyous#53 (shiv's 15:22 CDT merge grant) waits on it. Placed ahead of child-repo-gap (triage 12, Oct 29): it blocks that step's last merges.
